title: implementer_routed
description: The model for the issue's build step was chosen. Written by callum-flow-implementer-route before each build. Issues routed by hash are the fair sample for comparing the models.

model.description: The model alias chosen, for example sonnet or opus.

reason.description: label: a model:<alias> label on the issue; default: no Opus share is set; hash: the issue's bucket against the Opus share; fallback: the labels could not be read.

bucket.description: hash: the issue's stable bucket, 0 to 99 (Opus when below opus_pct); null otherwise.

opus_pct.description: The configured share of issues routed to Opus, in percent.
